name: kaminari-click-mcp
description: Traffic-quality statistics, saved reports, share links, and IP/UA reference databases from Kaminari Click.
long_description: Query Kaminari Click statistics (bots, IVT, conversions) grouped by time, sub IDs, geo, and device; manage and share saved reports; and check or download the IP/UA reference databases — all from your AI assistant.

api_key.title: MCP / Agent token
api_key.description: Generate it in the Kaminari Click account settings (MCP / Agent token). Do not use the regular API token.
